subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should persistent TUI footer customization be solved as a core TUI config template, a plugin-status-provider SDK/rendering seam, or kept out of the persistent footer for now?
rationale: The request crosses TUI layout, provider usage/quota data, auth-sensitive balance checks, public config, third-party cost tracking, and Plugin SDK extension points, so automation cannot safely choose the long-term product/API boundary.

options.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
options.body: Accept a status-provider-style extension boundary first, then add TUI rendering only after ordering, truncation, caching, redaction, and security policy are settled.

options.title: Core TUI footer template
options.body: Add first-class TUI config for template fields and accept the public config compatibility and migration burden.

options.title: Keep existing status surfaces
options.body: Treat /status, /usage, CLI status, and gateway usage APIs as the supported quota/cost surfaces and reject persistent footer customization for now.

recommendation.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
recommendation.body: Accept a status-provider-style extension boundary first, then add TUI rendering only after ordering, truncation, caching, redaction, and security policy are settled.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans current TUI footer/config code plus provider-usage/status surfaces, both tied to this person by current blame and related issue history.
